conventions: The labour counts of 2.2 and 2.18 divide alike: שִׁבְעִים → threescore and ten is one numeral unit headed on threescore (ten the competing head); סַבָּל → to bear burdens is one unit headed on burdens, the ASV having recast the agent noun as an infinitive phrase; חֹצֵב → that were hewers keeps the supplied relative and copula with the participle whether a noun precedes it (2.2, rule 41) or not (2.18, rule 46).

יוֹדֵעַ שֵׂכֶל/בִּינָה → endued with discretion/understanding (2.12, 2.13): the with is the English verb's valency preposition reaching the participle's bare object and stays with the participle under rule 44, not with the noun under rule 33; the head is endued.

In the provision list of 2.10 the supplied of before each commodity (of wheat, of barley, of wine, of oil) belongs to the commodity noun as a bare nominal under rule 33, not to the measure noun (כֹּר → measures, בַּת → baths) it stands after; in חִטִּים מַכּוֹת → of beaten wheat the of goes to חִטִּים, discontinuous around beaten.
report: Checked every candidate group and the added units end to end. No cross-verse split found: every difference in the table is one the ASV licenses (waw connectives read off the ASV; dative/benefactive לְ + suffix unrepresented wherever the ASV writes a bare object and aligned wherever it writes to/unto; the 'in gold and in silver' lists of 2.7 and 2.14 divide identically; the parallel labour counts of 2.2 and 2.18 divide identically — threescore and ten with its and inside the numeral, סַבָּל → to bear burdens headed on burdens, חֹצֵב → that were hewers keeping relative and copula; 2.1 and 2.12 'a house for his kingdom' identical; וְעַתָּה gives therefore to the waw in 2.7 and 2.15 and And to it in 2.13 as rule 14 directs; יוֹדֵעַ → endued with keeps the valency with in both 2.12 and 2.13; כֹּל present takes any/any manner in 2.14 while the כֹּל-less 'all manner of' in 2.7 is added).

2.2 עֲלֵיהֶם beside 'to oversee them' is unrepresented (object promoted to direct object, rule 40) while 2.11 עֲלֵיהֶם → 'over them' is aligned; the ASV wrote a word in one and not the other, so not a split.

BSB disagreements: the R×9 dative לְ, the Rd לַ of 2.4 (morning and evening written bare) and 2.10 (the ASV's one 'to' stands before thy servants, s013), and the Td×8 (heaven, gods, timber, Lebanon written bare, plus the assimilated articles of the metal lists) are all documented convention differences, not errors. 2.17 אֲנָשִׁים unrepresented beside 'the sojourners' is the one debatable item: rule 30's generic-noun fusion (אִישׁ before a class-naming attributive rendered by one English word) is worded for a participle or adjective, and הַגֵּירִים is an appositional noun, so the verse pass's reading is within the contract's letter; the fusion (s006+s008 → sojourners headed on גֵּר, articles unchanged) is the competing reading and is not a genuine error either way. Left as accepted.

2.7 'to be' added (עִם phrase is an adjunct of the infinitive clause, not a verbless-clause predicate) and 2.8 עִם → 'shall be with' (a true verbless clause after הִנֵּה) are two constructions, not one analysed two ways.
No promotion: the chapter teaches nothing general the contract lacks, and the one candidate (extending rule 30's אִישׁ fusion to an appositional noun) has no corpus precedent shown here.
